title: One polynomial. Two different jobs.
status: SILENT MAP STUDY · ORIGINAL NORMALIZED MODEL · NOT APPROVED

cues.heading: Start with points on x = 1
cues.caption: A line in the input plane is a set of points. Apply w = z².

cues.heading: Map points — not a force
cues.caption: Matching dots show z = 1 + iy and w = (1 − y²) + i(2y).

cues.heading: Return to the original x,y plane
cues.caption: Choosing V = x² − y² defines a local potential model, not the output plane.

cues.heading: Contour ≠ field line
cues.caption: Contours keep V constant. Field lines follow E, crossing regular contours at right angles.

cues.heading: Check the definition before the shape
cues.caption: Which curve is defined by mapping points into the u,v plane?

scale_label: Plot scales differ. Dot motion is a parameter sweep, not physical time.
potential_note: Local 2D model. E = 0 at origin; no field direction there.
sources: Point map → output curve; chosen potential → gradient field.
Original visuals. No RH, NS or common-physics claim.
